verzen.tekst: He who loves his son will continue to lay stripes upon him,
verzen.html: He who loves his son will continue to lay stripes upon him,

verzen.tekst: He who chastises his son will have profit from him,
verzen.html: He who chastises his son will have profit from him,

verzen.tekst: He who teaches his son will provoke his enemy to jealousy.
verzen.html: He who teaches his son will provoke his enemy to jealousy.

verzen.tekst: His father dies, and is as though he had not died;
verzen.html: His father dies, and is as though he had not died;

verzen.tekst: In his life, he saw his son and rejoiced.
verzen.html: In his life, he saw his son and rejoiced.

verzen.tekst: He left behind him an avenger against his enemies,
verzen.html: He left behind him an avenger against his enemies,

verzen.tekst: He who makes too much of his son will bind up his wounds.
verzen.html: He who makes too much of his son will bind up his wounds.

verzen.tekst: An unbroken horse becomes stubborn.
verzen.html: An unbroken horse becomes stubborn.

verzen.tekst: Pamper your child, and he will make you afraid.
verzen.html: Pamper your child, and he will make you afraid.

verzen.tekst: Don’t laugh with him, lest you have sorrow with him,
verzen.html: Don’t laugh with him, lest you have sorrow with him,

verzen.tekst: Give him no liberty in his youth,
verzen.html: Give him no liberty in his youth,

verzen.tekst: Bow down his neck in his youth,
verzen.html: Bow down his neck in his youth,

voetnoten.tekst: These three lines are absent from the oldest MSS.

verzen.tekst: Chastise your son, and give him work,
verzen.html: Chastise your son, and give him work,

verzen.tekst: Better is a poor man who is healthy and fit,
verzen.html: Better is a poor man who is healthy and fit,

verzen.tekst: Health and fitness are better than all gold,
verzen.html: Health and fitness are better than all gold,

verzen.tekst: There is no wealth better than health of body.
verzen.html: There is no wealth better than health of body.

verzen.tekst: Death is better than a bitter life,
verzen.html: Death is better than a bitter life,

verzen.tekst: Good things poured out upon a mouth that is closed
verzen.html: Good things poured out upon a mouth that is closed

verzen.tekst: What does an offering profit an idol?
verzen.html: What does an offering profit an idol?

verzen.tekst: seeing with his eyes and groaning,
verzen.html: seeing with his eyes and groaning,

verzen.tekst: Don’t give your soul to sorrow.
verzen.html: Don’t give your soul to sorrow.

verzen.tekst: Gladness of heart is the life of a man.
verzen.html: Gladness of heart is the life of a man.

verzen.tekst: Love your own soul, and comfort your heart.
verzen.html: Love your own soul, and comfort your heart.

verzen.tekst: Envy and wrath shorten life.
